verdict.rationale: Honeycomb has a public pricing page with a free-forever introductory plan whose limits are stated per signal type: up to 20M events and 100M metrics data points per month. That gives SREs some published, self-serve volume caps. However, the evidence shows no paid-tier prices or per-unit rates, so costs beyond the free tier cannot be predicted from it. Missing for 10: published paid-tier dollar pricing, per-event or per-data-point overage rates, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, confirmation that higher tiers are self-serve rather than sales-gated, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.
